## TRA Timeline

#### Bridge IPO TRA chain (pre-Apollo)

- 2021-06-16: Original Bridge Tax Receivable Agreement executed at Bridge's IPO (under Bridge CIK)
- 2022-01-01: First amendment to Bridge TRA (under Bridge CIK)

#### Apollo-Bridge merger and assumption

- 2025-02-23: Second Amended and Restated Tax Receivable Agreement signed alongside the Apollo-Bridge merger agreement; replaces the existing Bridge TRA in its entirety effective at merger close
- 2025-09-02: Bridge merger closes; Apollo Global Management Inc. becomes the obligor; $383M Bridge TRA liability recorded on Apollo's balance sheet

## Explanation

The Bridge TRA chain originated at Bridge Investment Group Holdings's June 16, 2021 IPO and was assumed by Apollo Global Management on September 2, 2025 when the Apollo-Bridge merger closed; the operative instrument is the Second Amended and Restated Tax Receivable Agreement dated February 23, 2025 (filed as Annex C to Apollo's S-4 and S-4/A, then to the final 424B3), under which Apollo replaced Bridge Corp. as the corporate obligor and committed to pay 85% of cash tax savings realized from the merger-driven Section 754 basis step-ups in Bridge Holdings to the former Bridge LLC Members. The contract carried forward the basis step-ups under a "No Termination Under the Existing Agreement" provision (no acceleration on the assumption). The FY2025 10-K confirms that as of December 31, 2025 no Bridge TRA holders retain operating units that could be exchanged, so this chain is also in run-off; no cash payments under the Bridge TRA have yet been disclosed. The parallel Apollo TRA (TRA-2013-05-06) is a separate contract with different beneficiaries. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
